correctness.rationale: The proof exhausts every factorization shape with \(\Omega(n)\le3\). Primes, prime squares, and prime cubes follow from exact formulas; squarefree semiprimes reduce to a finite size inequality; the \(p^2q\) branch is closed by an exact inequality plus divisibility modulo \(p\); and the \(2qr\) branch is closed by \((q-1)(r-1)\mid4q+4r+2\). Direct substitution verifies \(2,6,10,12,44\) and the sharpness witness \(90\).
